name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q01 - Internal energy change from heat and work

questiontext.text:
In a thermodynamic process, a system absorbs \(701\text{ J}\) of heat and delivers \(394\text{ J}\) of work to the surroundings. What is the change in internal energy (\(\Delta U\)) of the system?

एक ऊष्मागतिक प्रक्रम में, एक निकाय \(701\text{ J}\) ऊष्मा अवशोषित करता है और परिवेश पर \(394\text{ J}\) कार्य करता है। निकाय की आंतरिक ऊर्जा में परिवर्तन (\(\Delta U\)) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Heat absorbed by the system: \(q = +701\text{ J}\). Work done by the system on surroundings: \(w = -394\text{ J}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
By IUPAC conventions, heat absorbed by the system is positive (\(q > 0\)), and work done by the system on the surroundings is negative (\(w < 0\)).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
First Law of Thermodynamics: \[\Delta U = q + w\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Substitute the signed values into the First Law equation: \[\Delta U = (+701\text{ J}) + (-394\text{ J}) = +307\text{ J}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The energy entering as heat exceeds the energy leaving as work, confirming an increase in internal energy of \(+307\text{ J}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(+307\text{ J}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
निकाय द्वारा अवशोषित ऊष्मा: \(q = +701\text{ J}\)। निकाय द्वारा परिवेश पर किया गया कार्य: \(w = -394\text{ J}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
IUPAC परिपाटी अनुसार, निकाय द्वारा अवशोषित ऊष्मा धनात्मक (\(q > 0\)) तथा निकाय द्वारा किया गया कार्य ऋणात्मक (\(w < 0\)) होता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
ऊष्मागतिकी का प्रथम नियम: \[\Delta U = q + w\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
मान प्रतिस्थापित करने पर: \[\Delta U = (+701\text{ J}) + (-394\text{ J}) = +307\text{ J}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
आंतरिक ऊर्जा में नेट वृद्धि \(+307\text{ J}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(+307\text{ J}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q02 - Heat released during carbon dioxide formation

questiontext.text:
The enthalpy of combustion of carbon to \(\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}\) is \(-393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). How much heat is released upon formation of \(35.2\text{ g}\) of \(\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}\) from carbon and dioxygen gas? (Molar mass of \(\text{CO}_2 = 44.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\))

कार्बन से \(\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}\) के दहन की एन्थैल्पी \(-393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है। कार्बन और डाइऑक्सीजन गैस से \(35.2\text{ g}\) \(\text{CO}_2\text{(g)}\) बनने पर कितनी ऊष्मा मुक्त होगी? (\(\text{CO}_2\) का मोलर द्रव्यमान \(= 44.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\))

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass of \(\text{CO}_2\) produced: \(m = 35.2\text{ g}\). Molar mass of \(\text{CO}_2\): \(M = 44.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Standard enthalpy of combustion: \(\Delta_c H = -393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Combustion is complete. The term 'heat released' represents the positive magnitude of energy liberated to the surroundings.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Number of moles: \[n = \frac{m}{M}\] Heat released: \[q_{\text{released}} = n \times |\Delta_c H|\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate moles of \(\text{CO}_2\): \[n = \frac{35.2\text{ g}}{44.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}} = 0.80\text{ mol}\] Calculate total heat released: \[q_{\text{released}} = 0.80\text{ mol} \times 393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} = 314.8\text{ kJ}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Since \(0.80\text{ mol}\) is less than \(1.0\text{ mol}\), the heat released is proportionally \(314.8\text{ kJ}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(314.8\text{ kJ}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
निर्मित \(\text{CO}_2\) का द्रव्यमान: \(m = 35.2\text{ g}\)। मोलर द्रव्यमान \(M = 44.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)। दहन एन्थैल्पी \(\Delta_c H = -393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
दहन पूर्ण होता है। 'मुक्त ऊष्मा' उत्सर्जित तापीय ऊर्जा के धनात्मक परिमाण को व्यक्त करती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
मोल संख्या: \[n = \frac{m}{M}\] मुक्त ऊष्मा: \[q_{\text{released}} = n \times |\Delta_c H|\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
\(\text{CO}_2\) के मोल: \[n = \frac{35.2}{44.0} = 0.80\text{ mol}\] कुल मुक्त ऊष्मा: \[q_{\text{released}} = 0.80 \times 393.5 = 314.8\text{ kJ}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
\(0.80\text{ mol}\) \(\text{CO}_2\) बनने पर मुक्त ऊष्मा \(314.8\text{ kJ}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(314.8\text{ kJ}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q03 - Standard molar enthalpy of formation of ammonia

questiontext.text:
Given the balanced thermochemical equation:
\[\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\,\text{NH}_3\text{(g)},\quad \Delta_r H^\circ = -92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]
What is the standard molar enthalpy of formation (\(\Delta_f H^\circ\)) of gaseous ammonia?

संतुलित ऊष्मारसायनिक समीकरण दिया गया है:
\[\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\,\text{NH}_3\text{(g)},\quad \Delta_r H^\circ = -92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]
गैसीय अमोनिया की मानक मोलर विरचन एन्थैल्पी (\(\Delta_f H^\circ\)) क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Standard reaction enthalpy for forming \(2\text{ mol}\) of \(\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}\): \(\Delta_r H^\circ = -92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). The reactants are \(\text{N}_2\text{(g)}\) and \(\text{H}_2\text{(g)}\) in their standard reference states.

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Standard molar enthalpy of formation (\(\Delta_f H^\circ\)) is defined strictly for the formation of exactly one mole of substance from its elements in their standard reference states.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Since \(2\text{ mol}\) of \(\text{NH}_3\) are formed: \[\Delta_r H^\circ = 2\,\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] \implies \Delta_f H^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] = \frac{\Delta_r H^\circ}{2}\] logic applies strictly.

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Divide the overall reaction enthalpy by 2: \[\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] = \frac{-92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}}{2} = -46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The formation of 1 mole of ammonia from constituent elements is exothermic with a value of \(-46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
समीकरण में \(2\text{ mol}\) \(\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}\) बनने के लिए \(\Delta_r H^\circ = -92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)। तत्व मानक अवस्था में हैं।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
मानक मोलर विरचन एन्थैल्पी (\(\Delta_f H^\circ\)) की परिभाषा संदर्भ अवस्था में तत्वों से ठीक एक मोल यौगिक बनने के लिए लागू होती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
संबंध सूत्र: \[\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] = \frac{\Delta_r H^\circ}{2}\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
गणना: \[\Delta_f H^\circ = \frac{-92.4\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}}{2} = -46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
अमोनिया की मानक विरचन एन्थैल्पी \(-46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(-46.2\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q04 - Enthalpy of dilution upon adding solvent

questiontext.text:
The dissolution of \(1\text{ mol}\) of \(\text{HCl(g)}\) in \(25\text{ mol}\) of water evolves \(72.03\text{ kJ}\) of heat, while dissolution in \(40\text{ mol}\) of water evolves \(72.79\text{ kJ}\) of heat. What is the enthalpy of dilution (\(\Delta_{\text{dil}} H\)) when \(15\text{ mol}\) of water is added to the first solution?

\(25\text{ mol}\) जल में \(1\text{ mol}\) \(\text{HCl(g)}\) के घुलने पर \(72.03\text{ kJ}\) ऊष्मा निकलती है, जबकि \(40\text{ mol}\) जल में घुलने पर \(72.79\text{ kJ}\) ऊष्मा निकलती है। पहले विलयन में \(15\text{ mol}\) जल मिलाने पर तनुकरण एन्थैल्पी (\(\Delta_{\text{dil}} H\)) क्या होगी?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Enthalpy of solution in 25 mol of water: \(\Delta H_1 = -72.03\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Enthalpy of solution in 40 mol of water: \(\Delta H_2 = -72.79\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Heat evolved corresponds to negative enthalpy change. Enthalpy of dilution is the enthalpy difference between the final and initial states of dilution.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Hess's law: \[\Delta_{\text{dil}} H = \Delta H_2 - \Delta H_1\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the difference: \[\Delta_{\text{dil}} H = -72.79\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} - (-72.03\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}) = -72.79 + 72.03 = -0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The process of adding more water to dilute the acid solution releases additional heat, giving \(-0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(25\text{ mol}\) जल में विलयन एन्थैल्पी: \(\Delta H_1 = -72.03\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)। \(40\text{ mol}\) जल में विलयन एन्थैल्पी: \(\Delta H_2 = -72.79\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
ऊष्मा उत्सर्जन ऋणात्मक एन्थैल्पी परिवर्तन को दर्शाता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
हेस के नियमानुसार: \[\Delta_{\text{dil}} H = \Delta H_2 - \Delta H_1\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
मान घटाने पर: \[\Delta_{\text{dil}} H = -72.79 - (-72.03) = -0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
तनुकरण एन्थैल्पी \(-0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(-0.76\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q05 - Work done during constant external pressure expansion

questiontext.text:
An ideal gas expands from an initial volume of \(2.0\text{ L}\) to a final volume of \(10.0\text{ L}\) against a constant external pressure of \(1.0\text{ atm}\). Given that \(1\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 101.325\text{ J}\), what is the work done on the gas?

एक आदर्श गैस \(1.0\text{ atm}\) के नियत बाह्य दाब के विरुद्ध \(2.0\text{ L}\) से \(10.0\text{ L}\) तक प्रसारित होती है। दिया गया है कि \(1\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 101.325\text{ J}\), गैस पर किया गया कार्य क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Initial volume \(V_i = 2.0\text{ L}\), final volume \(V_f = 10.0\text{ L}\), external pressure \(p_{\text{ex}} = 1.0\text{ atm}\), conversion factor \(1\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 101.325\text{ J}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The expansion is irreversible against constant external pressure. Under IUPAC convention, work done on the gas during expansion is negative: \(w = -p_{\text{ex}}\Delta V\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Expansion work formula: \[w = -p_{\text{ex}}(V_f - V_i)\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Volume change: \[\Delta V = 10.0\text{ L} - 2.0\text{ L} = 8.0\text{ L}\] Work in litre-atmospheres: \[w = -(1.0\text{ atm})(8.0\text{ L}) = -8.0\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm}\] Convert to Joules: \[w = -8.0 \times 101.325\text{ J} = -810.6\text{ J}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The negative sign indicates work is done by the gas on the surroundings, giving \(-810.6\text{ J}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-810.6\text{ J}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(V_i = 2.0\text{ L}\), \(V_f = 10.0\text{ L}\), \(p_{\text{ex}} = 1.0\text{ atm}\), \(1\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm} = 101.325\text{ J}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
नियत बाह्य दाब के विरुद्ध प्रसार। IUPAC परिपाटी अनुसार गैस पर किया गया कार्य ऋणात्मक होता है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
कार्य सूत्र: \[w = -p_{\text{ex}}(V_f - V_i)\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
\(\Delta V = 10.0 - 2.0 = 8.0\text{ L}\)। \[w = -(1.0)(8.0) = -8.0\text{ L}\cdot\text{atm}\] जूल में: \[w = -8.0 \times 101.325 = -810.6\text{ J}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
गैस पर किया गया कार्य \(-810.6\text{ J}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(-810.6\text{ J}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q06 - Heat required using molar heat capacity

questiontext.text:
Calculate the heat required in kilojoules to raise the temperature of \(60.0\text{ g}\) of aluminium from \(35^\circ\text{C}\) to \(55^\circ\text{C}\). The molar heat capacity of aluminium is \(24.0\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\) and atomic mass is \(27.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

\(60.0\text{ g}\) ऐलुमिनियम का ताप \(35^\circ\text{C}\) से \(55^\circ\text{C}\) तक बढ़ाने के लिए आवश्यक ऊष्मा की गणना किलोजूल में कीजिए। ऐलुमिनियम की मोलर ऊष्मा धारिता \(24.0\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\) तथा परमाणु भार \(27.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Mass \(m = 60.0\text{ g}\), molar mass \(M = 27.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), molar heat capacity \(C_m = 24.0\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\), temperature change \(\Delta T = 55 - 35 = 20\text{ K}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Heating occurs without phase transition, so heat absorbed by the system is positive.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Moles: \[n = \frac{m}{M}\] Heat transferred: \[q = n \cdot C_m \cdot \Delta T\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate moles: \[n = \frac{60.0\text{ g}}{27.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}} = \frac{20}{9}\text{ mol} \approx 2.222\text{ mol}\] Calculate heat: \[q = \left(\frac{20}{9}\text{ mol}\right) \times (24.0\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}) \times (20\text{ K}) = \frac{9600}{9}\text{ J} \approx 1066.7\text{ J}\] Convert to kilojoules: \[q = \frac{1066.7\text{ J}}{1000} \approx 1.07\text{ kJ}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The total heat required is \(1.07\text{ kJ}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(1.07\text{ kJ}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(m = 60.0\text{ g}\), \(M = 27.0\text{ g}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(C_m = 24.0\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\), \(\Delta T = 20\text{ K}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
बिना प्रावस्था परिवर्तन के तापन; अवशोषित ऊष्मा धनात्मक होती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
मोल: \[n = \frac{m}{M}\] ऊष्मा: \[q = n \cdot C_m \cdot \Delta T\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
मोल संख्या: \[n = \frac{60.0}{27.0} = \frac{20}{9}\text{ mol}\] आवश्यक ऊष्मा: \[q = \frac{20}{9} \times 24.0 \times 20 = 1066.7\text{ J} = 1.07\text{ kJ}\] चरणबद्ध मान प्राप्त हुआ।

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
आवश्यक ऊष्मा \(1.07\text{ kJ}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(1.07\text{ kJ}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q07 - Standard reaction entropy calculation from third law

questiontext.text:
Given the standard molar entropies at \(298\text{ K}\): \(S^\circ[\text{N}_2\text{(g)}] = 191.5\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(S^\circ[\text{H}_2\text{(g)}] = 130.6\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), and \(S^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] = 192.3\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Calculate \(\Delta_r S^\circ\) for the reaction:
\[\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\,\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}\]

\(298\text{ K}\) पर मानक मोलर एन्ट्रॉपी मान हैं: \(S^\circ[\text{N}_2\text{(g)}] = 191.5\), \(S^\circ[\text{H}_2\text{(g)}] = 130.6\), तथा \(S^\circ[\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}] = 192.3\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)। अभिक्रिया के लिए \(\Delta_r S^\circ\) की गणना कीजिए:
\[\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\,\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}\]

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Standard entropies: \(S^\circ(\text{N}_2) = 191.5\), \(S^\circ(\text{H}_2) = 130.6\), \(S^\circ(\text{NH}_3) = 192.3\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Balanced equation: \(\text{N}_2\text{(g)} + 3\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow 2\,\text{NH}_3\text{(g)}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Standard entropies are absolute positive values defined relative to \(0\text{ K}\) by the Third Law of Thermodynamics.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Reaction entropy equation: \[\Delta_r S^\circ = 2\,S^\circ(\text{NH}_3) - [S^\circ(\text{N}_2) + 3\,S^\circ(\text{H}_2)]\]

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q09 - Spontaneity conditions of endothermic entropy driven reactions

questiontext.text:
For a chemical reaction, \(\Delta H = +35.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) and \(\Delta S = +83.6\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). At what minimum temperature will this reaction become spontaneous?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(\Delta H = +35.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} = +35500\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta S = +83.6\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Assume enthalpy and entropy changes are independent of temperature. Spontaneity at constant pressure requires \(\Delta G < 0\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Gibbs-Helmholtz relation: \[\Delta G = \Delta H - T\Delta S\] At the transition temperature (\(\Delta G = 0\)): \[T = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate threshold temperature: \[T = \frac{35500\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}}{83.6\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}} \approx 424.6\text{ K} \approx 425\text{ K}\] Since both \(\Delta H > 0\) and \(\Delta S > 0\), \(\Delta G < 0\) requires \(T > 425\text{ K}\).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The reaction becomes spontaneous only at temperatures strictly above \(425\text{ K}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: Above \(425\text{ K}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(\Delta H = 35500\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta S = 83.6\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
स्वतःप्रवर्तिता के लिए \(\Delta G = \Delta H - T\Delta S < 0\)।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
साम्य ताप सूत्र: \[T = \frac{\Delta H}{\Delta S}\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
गणना: \[T = \frac{35500}{83.6} \approx 425\text{ K}\] \(\Delta H > 0\) व \(\Delta S > 0\) होने से \(T > 425\text{ K}\) पर ही \(\Delta G < 0\) होगा।

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
\(425\text{ K}\) से ऊपर अभिक्रिया स्वतःप्रवर्तित होगी।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: Above \(425\text{ K}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q10 - Standard enthalpy of combustion calculation

questiontext.text:
The standard enthalpies of combustion of carbon(graphite), dihydrogen, and methane at \(298\text{ K}\) are \(-393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(-285.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), and \(-890.3\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) respectively. What is the standard enthalpy of formation of \(\text{CH}_4\text{(g)}\)?

\(298\text{ K}\) पर कार्बन(ग्रेफाइट), डाइहाइड्रोजन और मेथेन की मानक दहन एन्थैल्पियाँ क्रमशः \(-393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(-285.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) और \(-890.3\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) हैं। \(\text{CH}_4\text{(g)}\) की मानक विरचन एन्थैल्पी क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Standard combustion enthalpies: \(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{C}] = -393.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{H}_2] = -285.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = -890.3\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Formation target: \(\text{C(graphite)} + 2\,\text{H}_2\text{(g)} \rightarrow \text{CH}_4\text{(g)}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Standard enthalpy of formation equals the sum of combustion enthalpies of reactants minus products.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Hess's law: \[\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = \Delta_c H^\circ[\text{C}] + 2\,\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{H}_2] - \Delta_c H^\circ[\text{CH}_4]\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate: \[\Delta_f H^\circ = (-393.5) + 2(-285.8) - (-890.3)\] \[\Delta_f H^\circ = -393.5 - 571.6 + 890.3 = -965.1 + 890.3 = -74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The formation of methane is exothermic with \(\Delta_f H^\circ = -74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{C}] = -393.5\), \(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{H}_2] = -285.8\), \(\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = -890.3\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
हेस के नियमानुसार विरचन एन्थैल्पी की गणना अभिकारकों व उत्पाद की दहन एन्थैल्पियों से की जाती है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत
सूत्र: \[\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = \Delta_c H^\circ[\text{C}] + 2\,\Delta_c H^\circ[\text{H}_2] - \Delta_c H^\circ[\text{CH}_4]\]

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
गणना: \[\Delta_f H^\circ = -393.5 + 2(-285.8) - (-890.3) = -965.1 + 890.3 = -74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
मेथेन की मानक विरचन एन्थैल्पी \(-74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

अंतिम संकल्पनात्मक उत्तर: \(-74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

questiontext.text:

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Target equation is formed by subtracting equation (2) from equation (1): \[\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{CO}] = \Delta H_1 - \Delta H_2\]

The formation of carbon monoxide is exothermic, yielding \(-110.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-110.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध

\(\text{CO(g)}\) की विरचन एन्थैल्पी \(-110.5\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q15 - Reversible isothermal work done during ideal expansion

questiontext.text:
\(2.0\text{ mol}\) of an ideal gas expand reversibly and isothermally from an initial volume of \(10.0\text{ L}\) to a final volume of \(100.0\text{ L}\) at \(300\text{ K}\). Given \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) and \(\ln 10 = 2.303\), what is the work done on the gas?

\(300\text{ K}\) पर एक आदर्श गैस के \(2.0\text{ mol}\) उत्क्रमणीय और समतापीय रूप से \(10.0\text{ L}\) से \(100.0\text{ L}\) तक प्रसारित होते हैं। \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) और \(\ln 10 = 2.303\) लेते हुए, गैस पर किया गया कार्य क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:

Moles \(n = 2.0\text{ mol}\), temperature \(T = 300\text{ K}\), initial volume \(V_i = 10.0\text{ L}\), final volume \(V_f = 100.0\text{ L}\), gas constant \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Ideal gas expanding reversibly under isothermal conditions. By IUPAC convention, expansion work done on the system is negative.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Reversible isothermal work formula: \[w_{\text{rev}} = -2.303\,nRT\log_{10}\left(\frac{V_f}{V_i}\right)\]

The work done on the gas during expansion is \(-11.5\text{ kJ}\).

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q16 - Internal energy of vaporization of water film

questiontext.text:
The standard enthalpy of vaporization of water at \(373\text{ K}\) is \(40.66\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Assuming ideal gas behavior for water vapor and neglecting the volume of liquid, what is the internal energy of vaporization (\(\Delta_{\text{vap}} U\)) in \(\text{kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)? \(373\text{ K}\) पर जल के वाष्पीकरण की मानक एन्थैल्पी \(40.66\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है। जलवाष्प को आदर्श गैस मानते हुए तथा द्रव के आयतन को नगण्य मानते हुए, वाष्पीकरण की आंतरिक ऊर्जा (\(\Delta_{\text{vap}} U\)) \(\text{kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) में क्या है? (\(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) लें)

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
Enthalpy of vaporization: \(\Delta_{\text{vap}} H = 40.66\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). Temperature: \(T = 373\text{ K}\). Gas constant: \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
For \(\text{H}_2\text{O(l)} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{O(g)}\), \(\Delta n_g = 1 - 0 = 1\text{ mol}\). Steam behaves as an ideal gas and liquid volume is negligible.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Enthalpy-internal energy relationship: \[\Delta_{\text{vap}} H = \Delta_{\text{vap}} U + \Delta n_g RT \implies \Delta_{\text{vap}} U = \Delta_{\text{vap}} H - RT\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate the expansion work term: \[RT = (8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}) \times (373\text{ K}) = 3101.1\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} \approx 3.10\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\] Calculate internal energy of vaporization: \[\Delta_{\text{vap}} U = 40.66\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} - 3.10\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1} = 37.56\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
The internal energy of vaporization is smaller than the enthalpy of vaporization by the work of pushing back the atmosphere, yielding \(37.56\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(37.56\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

चरण 1: दिए गए मान एवं प्रतिबंध
\(\Delta_{\text{vap}} H = 40.66\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(T = 373\text{ K}\), \(R = 8.314\text{ J}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)।

चरण 2: मान्यताएँ एवं चिन्ह परिपाटी
\(\text{H}_2\text{O(l)} \rightarrow \text{H}_2\text{O(g)}\) के लिए \(\Delta n_g = 1\text{ mol}\)। द्रव आयतन नगण्य है।

चरण 3: संबंधित सूत्र एवं सिद्धांत

चरण 4: चरणबद्ध गणना
\[RT = 8.314 \times 373 = 3101.1\text{ J} \approx 3.10\text{ kJ}\] \[\Delta_{\text{vap}} U = 40.66 - 3.10 = 37.56\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\]

चरण 5: जाँच एवं अंतिम उत्तर
वाष्पीकरण की आंतरिक ऊर्जा \(37.56\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है।

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q17 - Enthalpy change on freezing of supercooled water

Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(n = 1.0\text{ mol}\), \(T = -10.0^\circ\text{C}\), \(\Delta_{\text{fus}} H^\circ = 6.03\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) at \(0^\circ\text{C}\), \(C_p(\text{l}) = 75.3\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\), \(C_p(\text{s}) = 36.8\text{ J}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\cdot\text{K}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
Construct a reversible three-step thermochemical path from \(\text{H}_2\text{O(l, }-10^\circ\text{C)}\) to \(\text{H}_2\text{O(s, }-10^\circ\text{C)}\): warm liquid to \(0^\circ\text{C}\), freeze at \(0^\circ\text{C}\), cool solid to \(-10^\circ\text{C}\).

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
By Hess's law: \[\Delta H = \Delta H_1 + \Delta H_2 + \Delta H_3\] where: \[\Delta H_1 = C_p(\text{l})\Delta T_1, \quad \Delta H_2 = -\Delta_{\text{fus}} H^\circ, \quad \Delta H_3 = C_p(\text{s})\Delta T_2\]

Freezing is an exothermic process, yielding \(-5.65\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(-5.65\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)

name.text: NEET_UG_CHEMISTRY_THERMODYNAMICS_MCQ_Q20 - Enthalpy of atomization and bond dissociation energy

questiontext.text:
The standard enthalpy of formation of gaseous methane (\(\text{CH}_4\text{(g)}\)) is \(-74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). The enthalpy of sublimation of carbon is \(+716.7\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) and the bond dissociation enthalpy of \(\text{H}_2\text{(g)}\) is \(435.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\). What is the mean \(\text{C}-\text{H}\) bond enthalpy in methane?

गैसीय मेथेन (\(\text{CH}_4\text{(g)}\)) की मानक विरचन एन्थैल्पी \(-74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है। कार्बन के ऊर्ध्वपातन की एन्थैल्पी \(+716.7\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) तथा \(\text{H}_2\text{(g)}\) की आबंध वियोजन एन्थैल्पी \(435.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\) है। मेथेन में माध्य \(\text{C}-\text{H}\) आबंध एन्थैल्पी क्या है?

generalfeedback.text:
Step 1: Given Data and Conditions
\(\Delta_f H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = -74.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta_{\text{sub}} H^\circ[\text{C}] = +716.7\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\), \(\Delta_{\text{bond}} H^\circ[\text{H}_2] = 435.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Step 2: Assumptions and Sign Conventions
The atomization of methane forms 1 mole of gaseous C atoms and 4 moles of gaseous H atoms. Methane has 4 identical \(\text{C}-\text{H}\) bonds on average.

Step 3: Relevant Formulae and Principles
Enthalpy of atomization of methane: \[\Delta_a H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = \Delta_{\text{sub}} H^\circ[\text{C}] + 2\,\Delta_{\text{bond}} H^\circ[\text{H}_2] - \Delta_f H^\circ[\text{CH}_4]\] Mean bond enthalpy: \[\Delta_{\text{C}-\text{H}} H = \frac{\Delta_a H^\circ[\text{CH}_4]}{4}\]

Step 4: Step-by-Step Working
Calculate atomization enthalpy of methane: \[\Delta_a H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = 716.7 + 2(435.8) - (-74.8)\] \[\Delta_a H^\circ[\text{CH}_4] = 716.7 + 871.6 + 74.8 = 1663.1\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\] Calculate mean \(\text{C}-\text{H}\) bond enthalpy: \[\Delta_{\text{C}-\text{H}} H = \frac{1663.1\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}}{4} \approx 415.8\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\] (NCERT canonical benchmark value \(\approx 416\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)).

Step 5: Check and Final Answer
Dividing the total atomization energy across 4 equivalent bonds yields \(416\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\).

Final Conceptual Answer: \(416\text{ kJ}\cdot\text{mol}^{-1}\)
